Computer Science.text: You showed interest in how software and computational systems are built and how they work.
You prefer to start from computing concepts and algorithms when solving a problem.
You enjoy algorithms and programming, and the satisfaction of solving a hard computational problem.

Data Science.text: You showed interest in working with data and discovering patterns.
You prefer to answer questions by analysing data and following the evidence.
You enjoy statistics and data analysis, and finding insights hidden in data.

Artificial Intelligence.text: You showed interest in intelligent and automated systems.
You prefer systems that learn, predict or make decisions.
You are drawn to artificial intelligence and to seeing a system perform a task intelligently.

Computer Security.text: You showed interest in testing systems and protecting them from vulnerabilities.
You prefer to investigate how a system could be attacked or compromised.
You enjoy operating-system and application security, and finding and fixing serious weaknesses.

Cyber Security.text: You showed interest in monitoring cyber threats and defending systems.
You prefer to look at how systems could be attacked and how to defend them.
You enjoy cyber threats, digital forensics and responding to security incidents.

Software Engineering.text: You showed interest in building software applications, often as part of a development team.
You prefer to design and build reliable software solutions.
You enjoy software architecture and development practices, and seeing people use what you build.

Computer Networks.text: You showed interest in designing, configuring and maintaining networks and infrastructure.
You prefer to examine how devices, networks and systems communicate.
You enjoy networking and cloud infrastructure, and getting complex systems working reliably.

Technology Management.text: You showed interest in managing technology, projects and teams.
You prefer to weigh how technology can serve business goals.
You enjoy business strategy and management, and leading technology projects.

Management Information Systems.text: You showed interest in improving business processes with information systems.
You prefer to consider how technology can best support business goals.
You enjoy business information systems and improving how an organization operates.
